text: What? Oh, I thought you already knew it...\nThis world is called Ver, and it's always spring\nthroughout the year.
There are two regions in Ver. One is Dia, the\nregion of daylight, where you were until a while\nago. And the other is Noche, the region of night.
My sister, Cersier tree is famous as the most\nbeautiful Yozakura, which means a cherry tree\nblossoms at night, in Noche.
The regions of daylight and night in the world of\nspiring? I've only been to the daylight one. But\nI can tell the region of night is strange.
